title: Who (whom), which and that 关系代词
description: A picture lesson introducing relative pronouns who, whom, which and that. Nine numbered pictures illustrate relative clauses: who served you (the man/woman behind the counter), who is making all that noise (the men repairing the road), who(m)/that I served yesterday (the man/woman/men), which/that book(s) on the counter, and which dog is yours (the dog carrying that basket). The written exercises rewrite sentences with who, whom or which and write questions and answers. The grammar workbook drills combining sentences with which/that and who/whom/that.
answer_note: Listening captions are model answers (suggested). Written exercises A (rewrite with who/whom/which), B and C (write questions and answers) are model answers (suggested). Workbook A (Who, whom, which and that) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-123-129.jpg), item 8 is a model answer (suggested, the workbook key is incomplete). Workbook B (Situations) is a model answer (suggested). Grammar I (combine with which/that) and II (combine with who/whom/that) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.557-558).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

Nine pictures (1-9): 1 Who served you? The man who/that is standing behind the counter. 2 Who served you? The woman who/that is standing behind the counter. 3 Who is making all that noise? The men who/that are repairing the road. 4 I served him yesterday. He is the man who(m)/that I served yesterday. 5 I served her yesterday. She is the woman who(m)/that I served yesterday. 6 I saw them yesterday. They are the men who(m)/that I saw yesterday. 7 Which book did you buy? The book which/that is on the counter. 8 Which books did you buy? The books which/that are on the counter. 9 Which dog is yours? The dog which/that is carrying that basket.
lesson.translation: 九张图片（1-9）：1 谁接待了您？站在柜台后面的那位男士。2 谁接待了您？站在柜台后面的那位女士。3 是谁弄出这么大的响声？那些正在修路的男士们。4 我昨天接待了他。他就是我昨天接待的那位男士。5 我昨天接待了她。她就是我昨天接待的那位女士。6 我昨天见到了他们。他们就是我昨天见到的那些男士。7 您买了哪本书？就是柜台上的那本书。8 您买了哪几本书？就是柜台上的那几本书。9 哪条狗是您的？就是叼着那只篮子的那条狗。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Listen to the recording and answer the questions for each picture (1-9).
lesson.translation: 听录音并回答每组图片（1-9）的问题。

questions.prompt: Picture 1: Who served you?
questions.answer: The man who/that is standing behind the counter.

questions.prompt: Picture 2: Who served you?
questions.answer: The woman who/that is standing behind the counter.

questions.prompt: Picture 3: Who is making all that noise?
questions.answer: The men who/that are repairing the road.

questions.prompt: Picture 4: I served him yesterday.
questions.answer: He is the man who(m)/that I served yesterday.

questions.prompt: Picture 5: I served her yesterday.
questions.answer: She is the woman who(m)/that I served yesterday.

questions.prompt: Picture 6: I saw them yesterday.
questions.answer: They are the men who(m)/that I saw yesterday.

questions.prompt: Picture 7: Which book did you buy?
questions.answer: The book which/that is on the counter.

questions.prompt: Picture 8: Which books did you buy?
questions.answer: The books which/that are on the counter.

questions.prompt: Picture 9: Which dog is yours?
questions.answer: The dog which/that is carrying that basket.

practice.title: Written exercise A
practice.instruction: Rewrite these sentences using who, whom or which. (Two examples are given.)
practice.translation: 用 who、whom 或 which 把以下每对句子改写成一句话。（已给出两个例子。）
practice.context: Model answers combining sentences with relative pronouns. Items 0a and 0b are the printed examples.

questions.prompt: Example a: She is the girl. She met me yesterday.
questions.answer: She is the girl who met me yesterday.

questions.prompt: Example b: This is the book. I bought it yesterday.
questions.answer: This is the book which I bought yesterday.

questions.prompt: This is the car. The mechanic repaired it yesterday.
questions.answer: This is the car which/that the mechanic repaired yesterday.

questions.prompt: He is the man. I invited him to the party.
questions.answer: He is the man who(m) I invited to the party.

questions.prompt: These are the things. I bought them yesterday.
questions.answer: These are the things which/that I bought yesterday.

questions.prompt: He is the man. He came here last week.
questions.answer: He is the man who/that came here last week.

questions.prompt: He is the policeman. He caught the thieves.
questions.answer: He is the policeman who/that caught the thieves.

questions.prompt: She is the nurse. She looked after me.
questions.answer: She is the nurse who/that looked after me.

questions.prompt: She is the woman. I met her at the party.
questions.answer: She is the woman who(m) I met at the party.

questions.prompt: I am the person. I wrote to you.
questions.answer: I am the person who/that wrote to you.

practice.title: Written exercise B
practice.instruction: Write questions and answers. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 模仿例句提问并回答。（已给出一个例子。）
practice.context: Model question-and-answer pairs using relative clauses. Item 0 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: He served me.
questions.answer: Who served you? That man? Yes, he's the man who served me.

questions.prompt: She met him.
questions.answer: Who did she meet? That man? Yes, he's the man who she met.

questions.prompt: He sat there.
questions.answer: Where did he sit? There? Yes, that's where he sat.

questions.prompt: She made it.
questions.answer: Who made it? She? Yes, she's the woman who made it.

questions.prompt: He read it.
questions.answer: Who read it? He? Yes, he's the man who read it.

questions.prompt: He shut it.
questions.answer: What did he shut? The door? Yes, that's the door which he shut.

questions.prompt: She took it.
questions.answer: Who took it? She? Yes, she's the woman who took it.

questions.prompt: He told me.
questions.answer: Who told you? That man? Yes, he's the man who told you.

questions.prompt: She saw me.
questions.answer: Who saw you? That woman? Yes, she's the woman who saw me.

practice.title: Written exercise C
practice.instruction: Write questions and answers. (One example is given.)
practice.translation: 模仿例句提问并回答。（已给出一个例子。）
practice.context: Model question-and-answer pairs using whom. Item 0 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I met him yesterday.
questions.answer: Whom did you meet yesterday? That man? Yes, he's the man whom I met yesterday.

questions.prompt: I saw him.
questions.answer: Whom did you see? That man? Yes, he's the man whom I saw.

questions.prompt: I telephoned her.
questions.answer: Whom did you telephone? That woman? Yes, she's the woman whom I telephoned.

questions.prompt: I invited him.
questions.answer: Whom did you invite? That man? Yes, he's the man whom I invited.

questions.prompt: I took him to the cinema.
questions.answer: Whom did you take to the cinema? That man? Yes, he's the man whom I took to the cinema.

questions.prompt: I found him in the garden.
questions.answer: Whom did you find in the garden? That man? Yes, he's the man whom I found in the garden.

questions.prompt: I drove her to London.
questions.answer: Whom did you drive to London? That woman? Yes, she's the woman whom I drove to London.

questions.prompt: I heard her.
questions.answer: Whom did you hear? That woman? Yes, she's the woman whom I heard.

questions.prompt: I remembered him.
questions.answer: Whom did you remember? That man? Yes, he's the man whom I remembered.

practice.title: Practice A: Who, whom, which and that
practice.instruction: Write answers to these questions using the prompts and who, whom, which or that. Show where you can use that in place of which, who or whom, who or whom. 按照提示回答以下问题，使用 who, whom, which 或 that。标出可用 that 取代 which, who 或 whom 的句子。
practice.translation: 按照提示回答以下问题，使用 who、whom、which 或 that。标出可用 that 取代 which、who 或 whom 的句子。
practice.key_source: img/key-123-129.jpg (Lesson 122 A); item 8 is a model answer (suggested, workbook key incomplete)
practice.context: Workbook L122 A: 8 items writing relative-clause answers; item 1 is the printed example; items 2-7 are from the workbook answer key, item 8 is a model answer.

questions.prompt: Which book are you looking for? (I bought it last week.)
questions.answer: I'm looking for the book which/that I bought last week.

questions.prompt: Which girl do you want to speak to? (She served me yesterday.)
questions.answer: I want to speak to the girl who/that served me yesterday.

questions.prompt: Which exercises did we do? (You can see them on page 244.)
questions.answer: We did the exercises which/that you can see on page 244.

questions.prompt: Which television are you going to buy? (You can buy it on instalments.)
questions.answer: I'm going to buy the television which/that you can buy on instalments.

questions.prompt: Which doctor did you ring? (He lives on the corner of our street.)
questions.answer: We rang the doctor who/that lives on the corner of our street.

questions.prompt: Which film did you see? (It's on at the Roxy Cinema.)
questions.answer: We saw the film which/that is on at the Roxy Cinema.

questions.prompt: Which actress are you talking about? (We saw her in a film last week.)
questions.answer: I'm talking about the actress whom/that we saw in a film last week.

questions.prompt: Which car did you want to buy? (They sold it yesterday.)
questions.answer: I wanted to buy the car which/that they sold yesterday.

practice.title: Practice B: Situations
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What do you say in each? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.translation: 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.context: Workbook L122 B: 4 situational responses; the workbook answer key is incomplete, so model answers are used.

questions.prompt: Someone asks if you can help her. How do you agree to the request?
questions.answer: Yes, I can help you. I'm the one who can help you.

questions.prompt: Someone asks you the date of another friend's birthday. How do you apologize and say you can't remember?
questions.answer: I'm sorry. I can't remember the date of her birthday.

questions.prompt: You want to move a desk, but it's too big to move alone. How do you ask a friend to help, beginning with 'Would you ...?'?
questions.answer: Would you help me move this desk? It's too big for me to move alone.

questions.prompt: You are looking for the woman who(m) you met yesterday. How do you describe her?
questions.answer: I'm looking for the woman who(m) I met yesterday.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Combine each pair of sentences, using 'which' or 'that'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 which 或 that 合并下列句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 which 或 that 合并下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.557-558 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 combine items using which/that; item 1 is the printed example. Items 3, 4, 9 and 10 accept two equivalent orderings in the key.

questions.prompt: The book is very interesting. / I'm reading the book.
questions.answer: The book which/that I'm reading is very interesting.

questions.prompt: The books were very expensive. / I bought the books.
questions.answer: The books which/that I bought were very expensive.

questions.prompt: The trees fell down. / The trees were big.
questions.answer: The trees which/that were big fell down. / The trees which/that fell down were big.

questions.prompt: The dresses were too expensive. / She wanted the dresses.
questions.answer: The dresses which/that she wanted were too expensive. / She wanted the dresses which/that were too expensive.

questions.prompt: She wants a doll for her birthday. / The doll walks and talks.
questions.answer: She wants a doll which/that walks and talks for her birthday. / The doll which/that she wants for her birthday walks and talks.

questions.prompt: I've lost the umbrella. / I bought the umbrella last week.
questions.answer: I've lost the umbrella which/that I bought last week.

questions.prompt: I passed the exams. / The exams were not very difficult.
questions.answer: I passed the exams which/that were not very difficult. / The exams which/that I passed were not very difficult.

questions.prompt: This is the car. / I've just bought the car.
questions.answer: This is the car which/that I've just bought.

questions.prompt: The street is called Fifth Avenue. / We are walking along the street.
questions.answer: The street which/that we are walking along is called Fifth Avenue. / We are walking along the street which/that is called Fifth Avenue.

questions.prompt: The store is across the street. / The store is the biggest in this city.
questions.answer: The store which/that is the biggest in this city is across the street. / The store which/that is across the street is the biggest in this city.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Combine each pair of sentences, using 'who', 'whom' or 'that'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 who、whom 或 that 合并下列句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 who、whom 或 that 合并下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.558 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 combine items using who/whom/that; item 1 is the printed example. Item 2 accepts two equivalent orderings in the key.

questions.prompt: The man is not here. / You were talking to the man.
questions.answer: The man who(m)/that you were talking to is not here.

questions.prompt: The teacher was standing at the front. / We handed the papers to the teacher.
questions.answer: The teacher who(m)/that we handed the papers to was standing at the front. / We handed the papers to the teacher who/that was standing at the front.

questions.prompt: I'm looking for someone. / He has a mobile phone to sell.
questions.answer: I'm looking for someone who/that has a mobile phone to sell.

questions.prompt: The young man is a doctor. / We just saw the young man.
questions.answer: The young man who(m)/that we just saw is a doctor.

questions.prompt: The person helped me. / The person was a stranger.
questions.answer: The person who/that helped me was a stranger.

questions.prompt: The man had run away with a lot of money. / The police wanted the man.
questions.answer: The man who(m)/that the police wanted had run away with a lot of money. / The police wanted the man who/that had run away with a lot of money.

questions.prompt: At last I met the man. / I had heard so much about the man.
questions.answer: At last I met the man who(m)/that I had heard so much about.

questions.prompt: The policemen are on traffic duty. / The policemen look very tired.
questions.answer: The policemen who/that are on traffic duty look very tired.

questions.prompt: This is the girl. / The girl found your money.
questions.answer: This is the girl who/that found your money.

questions.prompt: They looked for the men. / The men were selling tickets.
questions.answer: They looked for the men who/that were selling tickets.
